listing.name: Vanilla Faction Destroyer
listing.summary: Lets you destroy, weaken, or convert vanilla factions into pirates or independents at the start of a new game.
listing.aiSummary: Lets you destroy, weaken, or convert vanilla factions into pirates or independents at the start of a new game.

description:
Faction Destroyer

Get rid of the Vanilla factions

Source Code

The mod requires 
LunaLib

About

This mod gives you the option to apply any of the following effects to the vanilla factions at

New Game Start

- destroy (destroys their planets/stations)

- decimate (weakens them)

- turn to pirate (pirates take over the colonies of the faction)

- turn to independent

Its controlled via Luna Lib settings. (default setting removes all vanilla core factions, besides pirates and independents)

The factions in question are:

hegemony, tritachyon, sindrian_diktat, lions_guard, knights_of_ludd, luddic_church, luddic_path, persean_league, independent, pirates

For obvious reasons I recommend to not destroy independents and pirates.

Note that some mods might require the vanilla faction planets/stations to exist.

(ex: Knights of Ludd, PAGSM)

Secondary Function:

- at new game start, reduces any colony above size 8 to size 8. (max size can be changed)

Should work with any mod that doesnt need the faction planets/stations you opted to destroy.

Credits

wispborne/wisp for the wonderful Starsector-IntelliJ-Template and whoever wrote the guide at in the starsector.wiki.gg

The library creators LazyWizard/Lukas04 who make it possible to have in game mod settings.
